title: Persist speak/silent/clarify/escalate decisions and trace evidence
verify: `silent` creates no MessageEnvelope and no Bus event but records trace/eval evidence.
`speak`, `clarify`, and `escalate` create only valid, redacted MessageEnvelope records.
evidence_required: Trace evidence showing silent provider failure cannot be hidden as success.
constraints: `silent` cannot be used to hide provider failure as successful behavior.
All decisions preserve trace refs and redaction status.
invariants: Silent decision creates trace/eval evidence but no Bus publication.
Final output is grounded in structured observations and allowed context.
verification_targets: Clarify and escalate safe output behavior.
